title: Thirty-Two Years of Mrs. Okafor
subtitle: A retirement crossword from the Grade 4 class
footer: Sample puzzle. Names and facts are fictional.

entries.clue: The science fair project that went wrong
What she refused to give up for whiteboards
The one thing she always had behind her ear
Her dog, who visited every June
The lost art she taught anyway
Her first name, which no one may use
